name: OpenSEO
description: OpenSEO is an open-source, self-hosted alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs. It provides a focused, modern toolkit for keyword research, SERP analysis, backlink discovery, and site audits with a pay-as-you-go architecture (bring your own DataForSEO API key). Also features native Model Context Protocol (MCP) and AI SEO agent integration (SAM) for Claude Code, OpenClaw, and ChatGPT. Key Features: - Keyword Research & SERPs: Real-time search volumes, keyword difficulty, search intent, and live SERP rank tracking. - Backlink Analysis: Audit referring domains, anchor text distribution, and link authority. - Site Audits: Comprehensive technical SEO crawler checking broken links, meta tags, redirects, and Core Web Vitals. - AI Agent Integration (MCP): Connect AI coding assistants and use SAM (in-app SEO assistant powered by OpenRouter). - Pay-As-You-Go: No expensive monthly subscriptions; pay only for what you query using your own DataForSEO API credentials. - Privacy & Self-Hosted: All research data and local databases remain securely on your server. Initial Setup: 1. Set AUTH_MODE to local_noauth for local trusted network access (auto-logs in as admin@localhost), or use cloudflare_access for Cloudflare Zero Trust. 2. Provide your DATAFORSEO_API_KEY in the template settings or enter it directly inside the web UI. 3. Open http:// :[PORT:3001]/ after starting the container. Credits & Support: - OpenSEO is created by Ben Senescu / every-app ( GitHub | Website ). - The donation link below specifically supports the maintenance of this Unraid template repository.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Storage path for local database and configuration files.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: The port for the OpenSEO web interface (internal container port is 3001).

variables.name: DataForSEO API Key
variables.description: DataForSEO API key (Base64 login:password). Required for live keyword search, SERP data, and backlink analysis.

variables.name: Authentication Mode
variables.description: Authentication mode: 'local_noauth' for local trusted network (admin@localhost auto-login), 'cloudflare_access' for Cloudflare Access Zero Trust, or 'hosted' for email/password.

variables.name: Allowed Host
variables.description: Optional domain name or IP used to access OpenSEO when running behind a reverse proxy (e.g. seo.yourdomain.com).

variables.name: OpenRouter API Key
variables.description: Optional OpenRouter API key for SAM, the in-app AI SEO assistant.

variables.name: OpenRouter Model
variables.description: Model identifier for the AI assistant.

variables.name: Disable Telemetry
variables.description: Set to 'true' to disable anonymous usage heartbeat telemetry.

variables.name: Better Auth Secret
variables.description: Random secret (32+ characters) used to encrypt stored OAuth credentials (required for Google Search Console).

variables.name: Google Client ID
variables.description: Optional Google OAuth Client ID for Google Search Console integration.

variables.name: Google Client Secret
variables.description: Optional Google OAuth Client Secret for Google Search Console integration.

variables.name: Cloudflare Include Process Env
variables.description: Exposes Compose/Docker environment variables to cloudflare:workers runtime bindings.
